name: JAIRF
description: JAIRF MMORPG master roadmap. Four vertical quarters (jairf-1..4), cross-quarter production tracks (assets, audio, art style, animation, VFX, UI, budgets, builder constraints, quests, data arch, live-ops), beta testing swarm (jairf-beta), and the executable execution spine (jairf-exec). Parent map; each phase links to a child roadmap. Hybrid human + 300-agent swarm development in Unity 6.

phases.name: AI/HUM ROADMAP EXECUTION (jairf-exec) — EXECUTION SPINE
phases.notes: THE OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE. Follow this phase order for all work; supersedes the parallel parent listing. Every child roadmap feeds into it at its ordered step.

phases.name: Q1 Core Playable Foundation (jairf-1)
phases.notes: Character creation, movement, combat, inventory, progression, starter zone, UI, local co-op

phases.name: Digital Assets - 3D (jairf-assets)
phases.notes: Runs before/parallel to each quarter; Meshy text-to-3D pipeline

phases.name: Art Style (jairf-art-style)
phases.notes: Stylized fantasy lock; generator keyword consistency

phases.name: Animation (jairf-animation)
phases.notes: Humanoid rig, locomotion, combat, class, emotes, builder gestures, enemy/NPC

phases.name: VFX (jairf-vfx)
phases.notes: Combat, class abilities, feedback, environment, builder, UI, multiplayer

phases.name: UI / Icons / HUD (jairf-ui-icons)
phases.notes: Core HUD, inventory, skills, builder mode, social, system, status icons

phases.name: Tech Budgets & Naming (jairf-tech-budgets)
phases.notes: Poly/LOD, textures, performance targets, naming conventions, enforcement

phases.name: Q2 Persistent Multiplayer World (jairf-2)
phases.notes: Accounts, networking, dedicated server, zones, shared world, parties, chat, early economy

phases.name: Builder Constraints (jairf-builder-constraints)
phases.notes: Safety, budgets, permissions, persistence, moderation, safeguards

phases.name: Q3 Depth + Internal Builder (jairf-3)
phases.notes: Classes, quests, economy, guilds/housing, internal builder core + sharing

phases.name: Quest & Content Framework (jairf-quests)
phases.notes: Quest types, data schema, dialogue, content pillars, authoring rules

phases.name: Data Architecture (jairf-data-arch)
phases.notes: ScriptableObject-first, content data types, save/network schemas

phases.name: Q4 Polish, Scale & Live-Service (jairf-4)
phases.notes: Optimization, anti-cheat, advanced builder, balancing, packaging, soft-launch

phases.name: Localization / Accessibility / Live-Ops (jairf-liveops)
phases.notes: L10n, a11y, events, monetization, UGC moderation, CI/CD

phases.name: Beta Testing Swarm (jairf-beta)
phases.notes: Continuous across all quarters per Autonomous_Beta_Testing_Agents.md
